mapper.insert: insert into shop(shop_id, name, owner_name, phone, address, image, description, status, business_status, create_time, update_time) values(#{shopId}, #{name}, #{ownerName}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{image}, #{description}, #{status}, #{businessStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
select * from shop
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by create_time desc
mapper.update:
update shop
name = #{name},
owner_name = #{ownerName},
phone = #{phone},
address = #{address},
image = #{image},
description = #{description},
status = #{status},
business_status = #{businessStatus},
update_time = #{updateTime},
where shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.select: select * from shop where status = 1 order by create_time desc
